caption_L2L3: 2009 was the lowest recorded number of exports during this period with only 5000. This then steadily rose until 2011 where there was a very tiny dip in the numbers for that year only. Between 2012 and 2014 there was a very steep increase where the number of exports rose by over 2000. It then remained fairly steady, at around 8,000 with a very slight dip in 2016. 2018 saw a spike in the numbers to 8500, then there was a small dip before recording finished in 2019 on 7500.
